title: How QR transfers work
summary: Explains the QR transfer flow: a QR code generated for 17 units of validity, scanned via the payer’s in-app scanner, validated in-app, optionally requiring “Yes” approval before funds move, then submitted to complete the transfer. Covers the QR lifecycle (Created/Scanned/Confirmed/Completed) and reasons transfers won’t proceed (QR older than 17, dismissing during Yes review, connectivity issues).
faqs: How long is a generated QR code valid for a transfer?
What steps happen after the payer scans the QR in the app?
When does the “Yes” prompt appear, and when do funds actually move?
What does the QR code lifecycle look like from Created to Completed?
Why might a QR transfer not proceed (expired QR, dismissing during review, connectivity issues)?
What practical steps can I take to avoid issues (e.g., scan promptly within the validity window)?
